messages:
emily-partnerships: Quick sync — prepping a cloud marketplace listing that bundles Redwood Dedicated + optional Optimize add-on across AWS/GCP/Azure. Main asks: SKU granularity, legal artifacts (EULA/DPA), AMI vs SaaS packaging, and owners. Target: ~2 weeks.
ryan-legal: Important: AWS and Azure require different EULA attachments; GCP wants a DPA checkbox too. We need a single EULA that covers SaaS + AMI variants or two separate docs. Also confirm data residency language for EU customers.
ana-product: Proposal: publish a base SKU + optional add-on SKU model. That keeps pricing flexible and maps to billing easily. Example SKUs: `REDWOOD_DEDICATED`, `REDWOOD_OPTIMIZE_ADDON`. Thoughts?
tom-engineering: For GCP's metered billing we need a usage-reporting endpoint (monthly) and a metering SKU id. AWS SaaS contracts can accept usage reports too but AMI/offering is different (AMI -> one-time subscription or hourly AMI). We should decide: SaaS listing (recommended) + AMI for customers needing air-gapped.
ryan-legal: +1 on separate docs for AMI vs SaaS. AMI customers are contractual; easier on license terms. SaaS needs DPA and subprocessors list. I'll draft EULA + DPA templates but need product wording for feature boundaries.
jess-marketing: We also need listing assets: logos (SVG + 1200x600 PNG), a 60s product video, 3 screenshots (console, metrics, billing view), and a short 250-char tagline. Can we lock these by EOD Friday?
emily-partnerships: Owners: Product = @ana-product, Legal = @ryan-legal, Eng = @tom-engineering, Marketing = @jess-marketing. I'll own publisher onboarding and signoffs.
marketplace-bot: :package: Reminder: publisher ID and publisher verification are required for AWS/GCP/Azure. Publisher verification ETA can be 2-3 business days after form submission.
tom-engineering: Also a technical note: for AMI we'll need AMI IDs per region (us-west-2, eu-west-1, ap-southeast-1). Engineering will build and snapshot AMIs, but need a list of target regions.
ana-product: Target regions: US-WEST-2, US-EAST-1, EU-WEST-1 to start. We can expand later.
ryan-legal: Marketing, please avoid marketing claims about 'SLA-backed' in marketplace description unless Sales/Contracts has signed SLA. We can say 'SLA options available' instead.
jess-marketing: Noted. Will swap phrasing. Also: any constraints on screenshots (no customer data)?yan-legal: No customer data in images, please blur anything PII. Also include a privacy contact email in the listing metadata.
emily-partnerships: Logistics checklist I'm tracking: publisher verification, SKU mapping doc, EULA + DPA drafts, AMI build plan + region list, metering endpoint (GCP), listing assets, pricing sheet. I'll post a formal checklist in Confluence after this thread.
tom-engineering: Quick API note for billing: usage endpoint should accept CSV + JSON payloads and return 202. We'll add a lightweight webhook consumer. I'll open a ticket and tag @ana-product.
ana-product: Thanks — please include sample payload schema in the ticket.
emily-partnerships: Timeline callout: submit publisher forms + assets by next Tue, legal drafts by Wed, engineering metering + AMIs in progress same week. Launch window: two weeks if no blockers.
jess-marketing: I'll start assets today and ping for reviews.yan-legal: I'll start EULA/DPA drafts — will share comments inline by Wednesday.
emily-partnerships: Great. Two quick edge cases: 1) Marketplace trial vs free tier handling — AWS wants a separate SKU for trials; 2) Bundles where customer buys Dedicated + Optimize discount needs to be represented in listing pricing. Anyone got prior templates for AWS trial SKU setup?
tom-engineering: We implemented trial SKU for a previous partner — it's a distinct SKU with 0 price for X days then transitions. Engineering needs the SKU IDs and transition rules.
aana-product: (typo) oops — meant @ana-product. I'll compile a pricing table with trial flow and bundling discounts, post here.
emily-partnerships: Perfect. I'll follow up with a short kickoff cal tomorrow 10am PT to confirm region list and legal redlines. If anyone can't make it, drop notes here. :calendar: :thumbsup:
